items.title: Ted Piltzecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 10, 2019
items.q: This is like Mozart, I mean this guy has some kind of processing power that’s really magnificent.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, written out. I mean not just the blowing part, but this was before, over the chorus or something. But it went on for several choruses. Right? I studiously, I worked really hard on this thing and it was sort of cool you know. And yet, and he says this to the audience, and then he sits down and he plays all three parts flawlessly. He had never played them before. He had heard them, because we had done them on the tour, but he just goes bamm, and the entire fugue happened, right? Right there in front of my…
That’s a good way to put it, processing power.
